data.about: The same two-point problem solved through the resultant: split R at any point M₁ of its line of action into two forces toward the prescribed points; parallels to those two chords through the ends of the load line intersect at the pole.

steps.caption: step through with the slider, press play, or use ←/→
steps.title: How to draw this scheme

steps.caption: left: three loads with their lines of action — right: stacked tip-to-tail on the load line I→J→K→L
steps.title: The loads — in both diagrams

steps.caption: left: the funicular must pass through E₃ and G₃ (dashed guides ∥ the load line)
steps.title: Two points to pass through

steps.caption: right: place a trial pole o′ anywhere — it only serves to find R's position
steps.title: Trial pole o′

steps.caption: right: ray o′–L — left: start at H₃ on E₃'s guide, parallel to it, up to line of action 1
steps.title: Trial ray o′–L

steps.caption: right: ray o′–K — left: continue parallel to it to line of action 2
steps.title: Trial ray o′–K

steps.caption: right: ray o′–J — left: continue parallel to it to line of action 3
steps.title: Trial ray o′–J

steps.caption: right: ray o′–I — left: continue parallel to it to G₃'s guide → S
steps.title: Trial ray o′–I

steps.caption: both sides at once: extend trial strings 1 and 4 → U locates R (left), and R = I→L on the load line (right), both dashed green
steps.title: The resultant, located

steps.caption: left: pick ANY point M₁ on R's line of action — R may be split into two forces there
steps.title: Choose M₁

steps.caption: left: dashed chord E₃–G₃, and orange chords M₁–E₃, M₁–G₃: the one-load funicular through both points
steps.title: The funicular of R alone

steps.caption: right: through L parallel to M₁–E₃, through I parallel to M₁–G₃ (orange) — they intersect at the pole o
steps.title: The pole o

steps.caption: right: L–o — left: from E₃ parallel to it → node I on line of action 1
steps.title: Segment 1 — form and force

steps.caption: right: K–o — left: parallel to it → node II
steps.title: Segment 2 — form and force

steps.caption: right: J–o — left: parallel to it → node III
steps.title: Segment 3 — form and force

steps.caption: right: I–o — left: parallel to it from III — it lands exactly on G₃, and strings 1, 4 extended pass through M₁
steps.title: Segment 4 — form and force

steps.caption: the funicular through E₃ and G₃ resolves pink = tension (the grey trial stays as a record of the construction)
steps.title: Tension
